basic_details.job_title: MDU Field Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak (MDU) has announced 1 vacancy for the Field Staff post on a temporary basis, not exceeding 19 months and purely co-terminus with the project. Eligible candidates must submit a detailed CV along with relevant self-attested documents, valid photo ID and complete contact details through email with the subject line 'Field Staff position in HSHEC Project' by the last date of 26 October 2026. qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Post Graduate in any discipline along with M.Ed with a minimum of 55% marks, subject to a 5% relaxation allowed to SC/ST or persons with disabilities as per M.D. University, Rohtak rules. Candidates having B.Ed (Special Edu) or M.Ed (Special Education) and UGC NET/JRF may be preferred.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview of eligible candidates who submit their detailed CV and required documents by the stipulated deadline.
important_instructions: All candidates are required to bring original documents at the time of interview along with one self-attested copy of documents. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Nature of appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project as per HSRF norms. Applications must include a detailed CV, relevant self-attested documents, valid photo ID, and complete contact details (email ID and mobile number).

content_sections.heading: MDU Field Staff at a Glance

rows.details: Post Graduate in any discipline with M.Ed (minimum 55% marks)
Government Schools of Haryana / Department of Education, M.D. University, Rohtak

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their application by email to the Principal Investigator at the official email address. Email Address: [email protected] Subject Line: Field Staff position in HSHEC Project Deadline: 26 October 2026

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Post Graduate in any discipline along with M.Ed with a minimum of 55% marks, subject to a 5% relaxation allowed to SC/ST or persons with disabilities as per M.D. University, Rohtak rules. Candidates having B.Ed (Special Edu) or M.Ed (Special Education) and UGC NET/JRF may be preferred.

content_sections.heading: MDU Field Staff Job Description
content_sections.text: Tool construction, conduct field work and data collection from Government Schools of Haryana. Assist in data compilation, analysis and documentation of research findings. Perform project-related research work as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an interview of eligible candidates who submit their detailed CV and required documents by the stipulated deadline.

content_sections.heading: MDU Field Staff Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All candidates are required to bring original documents at the time of interview along with one self-attested copy of documents. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Nature of appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project as per HSRF norms. Applications must include a detailed CV, relevant self-attested documents, valid photo ID, and complete contact details (email ID and mobile number).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for MDU Field Staff?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Field Staff post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MDU Field Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in any discipline along with M.Ed with a minimum of 55% marks, subject to relaxation rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary or monthly emolument for MDU Field Staff?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly emolument of Rs. 15,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q5. How should I apply for the Field Staff position?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their detailed CV, self-attested documents, valid photo ID, and contact details via email to [email protected] with the subject line 'Field Staff position in HSHEC Project'.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an interview scheduled for 30 October 2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Field Staff position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the nature of appointment is purely temporary, not exceeding 19 months, and co-terminus with the project as per HSRF norms.

faq.question: Q8. What should be written in the email subject line while applying?
faq.answer: Applicants must write 'Field Staff position in HSHEC Project' in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any desirable qualifications specified in the notice?
faq.answer: Candidates having B.Ed (Special Edu) or M.Ed (Special Education) and UGC NET/JRF may be preferred.
